title.zh: EVE 学院：虫洞战斗站点

blocks.en: If you're looking to take your PvE combat to the next level,
blocks.zh: 如果你想让自己的 PvE 战斗更上一层楼，

blocks.en: look no further than wormhole space.
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间就是不二之选。

blocks.en: Wormhole systems exist separately from the rest of New Eden,
blocks.zh: 虫洞星系独立于新伊甸的其他区域，

blocks.en: and the combat sites found there
blocks.zh: 那里的战斗站点

blocks.en: offer a unique challenge with tempting rewards.
blocks.zh: 提供独特的挑战和诱人的奖励。

blocks.en: To find a wormhole combat site,
blocks.zh: 要找到虫洞战斗站点，

blocks.en: you'll first need to find a wormhole system.
blocks.zh: 首先得找到一个虫洞星系。

blocks.en: These can be scanned down from almost anywhere in New Eden.
blocks.zh: 在新伊甸几乎任何地方都能扫出虫洞。

blocks.en: Check out the wormhole basics video to find out more.
blocks.zh: 详情请观看《虫洞基础》视频。

blocks.en: In this tutorial,
blocks.zh: 在本教程中，

blocks.en: we will be focusing on the type of wormhole
blocks.zh: 我们将专注于站点最简单的

blocks.en: with the easiest sites: a class 1 system.
blocks.zh: 那类虫洞：C1 星系。

blocks.en: Before you head out on your wormhole expedition,
blocks.zh: 在出发进行虫洞远征之前，

blocks.en: you need to prepare your ship.
blocks.zh: 你需要准备好舰船。

blocks.en: Even the easiest wormhole sites can be much harder than most missions,
blocks.zh: 即使是最简单的虫洞站点，也可能比大多数任务难得多，

blocks.en: so you should fit up a combat battlecruiser to take them on.
blocks.zh: 所以你应该装配一艘战斗战列巡洋舰来应对。

blocks.en: Take a look at the Fitting Your Ship video
blocks.zh: 请观看《舰船装配入门》视频，

blocks.en: to learn more how you can effectively design a fit for purpose.
blocks.zh: 了解如何有效地按用途设计配置。

blocks.en: Do note that wormhole sleeper sites tend to have a lot of energy neutralizers,
blocks.zh: 注意，虫洞里的冬眠者站点往往有大量能量中和器，

blocks.en: so be sure your ship is able to comfortably maintain its capacitor.
blocks.zh: 所以要确保你的船能轻松维持电容。

blocks.en: If you're flying solo,
blocks.zh: 如果你单人行动，

blocks.en: you may want to consider fitting a Core Probe Launcher
blocks.zh: 不妨考虑装一个核心探针发射器

blocks.en: with a set of Core Scanner Probes just in case.
blocks.zh: 并带上一组核心扫描探针，以防万一。

blocks.en: This will help ensure that you always have a way out
blocks.zh: 这样即使你进来的虫洞坍塌了，

blocks.en: if your entry wormhole collapses.
blocks.zh: 也能确保你总有办法出去。

blocks.en: Another option is to bring a Mobile Depot which you can anchor,
blocks.zh: 另一个选择是带一个移动式仓库，可以锚定在太空中，

blocks.en: and use in space to refit a probe launcher onto your ship from the cargo.
blocks.zh: 用它把货舱里的探针发射器重新装到船上。

blocks.en: You should also consider picking up a Mobile Tractor Unit to collect wrecks.
blocks.zh: 你还应该考虑带一个移动式牵引装置来收集残骸。

blocks.en: More on that later.
blocks.zh: 稍后会详细介绍。

blocks.en: Once your battlecruiser is ready for action,
blocks.zh: 战列巡洋舰准备就绪后，

blocks.en: you can head back to the wormhole you found earlier.
blocks.zh: 就可以回到之前找到的虫洞。

blocks.en: Steel yourself and jump in.
blocks.zh: 鼓起勇气，跳进去。

blocks.en: Now that you're in wormhole space,
blocks.zh: 现在你已身处虫洞空间，

blocks.en: you should see a selection of green anomalies in your Probe Scanner.
blocks.zh: 应该能在探针扫描器中看到一些绿色的异常。

blocks.en: Many of these will be combat sites that you can warp to.
blocks.zh: 其中很多是可以直接跃迁过去的战斗站点。

blocks.en: Pick one, and warp to it.
blocks.zh: 挑一个，跃迁过去。

blocks.en: As you land in the combat site,
blocks.zh: 降落在战斗站点后，

blocks.en: you'll encounter a small number of hostile NPCs.
blocks.zh: 你会遇到少量敌对 NPC。

blocks.en: These are Sleeper drones,
blocks.zh: 这些是冬眠者无人机，

blocks.en: and you'll find them much tougher than the pirates you're used to.
blocks.zh: 你会发现它们比你熟悉的海盗强悍得多。

blocks.en: Lock them up, and start firing.
blocks.zh: 锁定它们，开火。

blocks.en: This is a good time to drop your Mobile Tractor Unit and bookmark it.
blocks.zh: 这时正好可以放下移动式牵引装置，并给它保存书签。

blocks.en: It will collect loot for you whilst you focus on surviving.
blocks.zh: 在你专心求生的同时，它会帮你收集战利品。

blocks.en: Remember that PvP is allowed in wormhole space
blocks.zh: 记住，虫洞空间允许 PvP，

blocks.en: so you should be on the lookout for hostile players, too.
blocks.zh: 所以你也要留意敌对玩家。

blocks.en: Sleeper drones work on a trigger system
blocks.zh: 冬眠者无人机采用触发机制

blocks.en: for spawning the next wave of combat ships.
blocks.zh: 来刷出下一波战斗舰船。

blocks.en: Killing the last of the trigger ships will spawn more NPCs
blocks.zh: 击杀最后一艘触发舰船会刷出更多 NPC，

blocks.en: until you complete the site.
blocks.zh: 直到你完成站点。

blocks.en: You can find out which ships are the trigger through experience,
blocks.zh: 可以通过经验，或查阅克隆飞行员制作的

blocks.en: or by checking resources created by Capsuleers online.
blocks.zh: 在线资料，来了解哪些舰船是触发目标。

blocks.en: Once you've cleared out the Sleeper infestation,
blocks.zh: 清除了盘踞的冬眠者之后，

blocks.en: head to your Mobile Tractor Unit,
blocks.zh: 前往你的移动式牵引装置，

blocks.en: and take a look at the unique loot inside.
blocks.zh: 看看里面独特的战利品。

blocks.en: It will have collected valuable Sleeper artifacts
blocks.zh: 它会收集到珍贵的冬眠者文物，

blocks.en: known to most Capsuleers as "blue loot".
blocks.zh: 大多数克隆飞行员称之为「蓝色战利品（blue loot）」。

blocks.en: Collect your spoils and don't forget to scoop up your tractor unit.
blocks.zh: 收好战利品，别忘了把牵引装置收回来。

blocks.en: Congratulations on completing your first wormhole combat site.
blocks.zh: 恭喜你完成了第一个虫洞战斗站点。

blocks.en: What you do now is up to you.
blocks.zh: 接下来做什么就由你决定了。

blocks.en: Salvaging Sleeper wrecks can be very profitable.
blocks.zh: 打捞冬眠者残骸可能非常赚钱，

blocks.en: and will help you extract more value out of each site.
blocks.zh: 能帮你从每个站点榨取更多价值。

blocks.en: You might also want to head back to your Highsec wormhole bookmark
blocks.zh: 你可能还想回到通往高安的虫洞书签处，

blocks.en: to secure your loot away from the clutches of hostile Capsuleers.
blocks.zh: 把战利品安全带走，免得落入敌对克隆飞行员之手。

blocks.en: To profit from your blue loot, you need to sell it on the market.
blocks.zh: 要靠蓝色战利品赚钱，你需要在市场上出售。

blocks.en: Fortunately, there are NPC buy orders available in systems across New Eden.
blocks.zh: 幸运的是，新伊甸各地的星系里都有 NPC 买单。

blocks.en: To find one,
blocks.zh: 要找到合适的买单，

blocks.en: look for the highest value buy order,
blocks.zh: 就看出价最高的那个，

blocks.en: and head to that station to sell your loot.
blocks.zh: 然后前往那个空间站出售战利品。

blocks.en: NPC buy orders will also be set for a flat amount,
blocks.zh: NPC 买单的价格是固定的，

blocks.en: such as the Sleeper Data Library which sells for 500,000 ISK each.
blocks.zh: 例如冬眠者数据库每个可卖 500,000 ISK。

blocks.en: Now that you're prepared to take on wormhole sites,
blocks.zh: 现在你已经准备好挑战虫洞站点，

blocks.en: you're ready to get into some of the most rewarding PvE content there is.
blocks.zh: 可以开始体验收益最丰厚的 PvE 内容之一了。

blocks.en: Get out there and test yourself
blocks.zh: 出发吧，在虫洞空间的深处

blocks.en: in the depths of wormhole space.
blocks.zh: 考验你自己。
